question.:question/problem:
How can we best describe the following matrix? 

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & -7\end{aligned}]
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Notice that $A$ is a matrix for which all entries below the diagonal are $0$'s:

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & -7\end{aligned}]
$$

Therefore, it is an upper triangular matrix.

It is not a lower triangular matrix or a diagonal matrix since there is a non-zero element above the diagonal: ${a}_{23}=3\ne 0.$
